```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(r2d3)

set.seed(42)
 
study_params <- tibble(
  STUDYID    = c("STUDY001", "STUDY002", "STUDY003"),
  n_subjects = c(80, 58, 102),    # subjects per study
  lloq       = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),  # shared LLOQ across studies
  cl_pop     = c(1.2, 1.4, 1.5),  # population CL - controls BLQ rate
  vd_pop     = c(50, 50, 50),     # population Vd
  # Subject-level non-compliance rate (drives EXCFL)
  excl_rate  = c(0.032, 0.037, 0.033),
  # Sample-level deletion rate among retained subjects (drives DELFLAG)
  del_rate   = c(0.058, 0.093, 0.072),
  # Stochastic BLQ supplement removed 
  blq_rate   = c(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
)
 
# Nominal timepoints (hrs post-dose)
ntfd_schedule <- c(0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 36, 48, 72, 96, 120)
 
 
# One-compartment PK: C(t) = (Dose/Vd) * exp(-CL/Vd * t)
# Parameters drawn with between-subject variability (lognormal)
sim_pk <- function(ntfd, dose = 100, cl_pop = 5, vd_pop = 50, bsv_cv = 0.3) {
  cl <- cl_pop * exp(rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = bsv_cv))
  vd <- vd_pop * exp(rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = bsv_cv))
  ke <- cl / vd
  conc <- (dose / vd) * exp(-ke * ntfd)
  # Add residual lognormal error (20% CV)
  conc * exp(rnorm(length(ntfd), mean = 0, sd = 0.2))
}
 
 
sim_study <- function(STUDYID, n_subjects, lloq, cl_pop, vd_pop, excl_rate, del_rate, blq_rate) {
 
  # Subject IDs
  subjects <- tibble(
    STUDYID = STUDYID,
    USUBJID  = sprintf("%s-%03d", STUDYID, seq_len(n_subjects))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Subject-level exclusion flag applied to ALL records for flagged subjects
      EXCFL   = if_else(runif(n()) < excl_rate, "Y", "N")
    )
 
  # Expand to one row per subject × timepoint
  pk_data <- subjects %>%
    cross_join(tibble(NTFD = ntfd_schedule)) %>%
    arrange(USUBJID, NTFD)
 
  # Simulate DV for each subject
  pk_data <- pk_data %>%
    group_by(USUBJID) %>%
    mutate(DV = sim_pk(NTFD, cl_pop = cl_pop, vd_pop = vd_pop)) %>%
    ungroup()
 
  # Sample-level deletion flag - only among non-excluded subjects
  pk_data <- pk_data %>%
    mutate(
      DELFLAG = if_else(EXCFL == "N" & runif(n()) < del_rate, "Y", "N")
    )
 
  # BLQ flag, applied after exclusion and deletion filters conceptually,
  # but stored on all rows; only meaningful on retained samples.
  # Two sources of BLQ:
  #   1. DV naturally falls below LLOQ (trough timepoints)
  #   2. Additional stochastic BLQ to hit target rate
  pk_data <- pk_data %>%
    mutate(
      BLQ = if_else(DV < lloq, "Y", "N"),
      DV  = if_else(BLQ == "Y", lloq / 2, DV)
    )
 
  pk_data
}
 
 
adpc <- pmap_dfr(study_params, sim_study)
 
# Final column selection and ordering
adpc <- adpc %>%
  select(STUDYID, USUBJID, NTFD, DV, EXCFL, DELFLAG, BLQ)
 
glimpse(adpc)

# checks
## check EXCFL is same within an ID
adpc |> 
  group_by(USUBJID) |> 
  summarise(nd = n_distinct(EXCFL)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  count(nd)
 

 
# build_attrition_paths
 build_attrition_paths <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      r1 = STUDYID,
      r2 = case_when(
        EXCFL == "Y" ~ "Excluded-Subject",
        TRUE         ~ "Compliant"
      ),
      r3 = case_when(
        EXCFL == "Y"   ~ "-",
        DELFLAG == "Y" ~ "Sample-Deleted",
        TRUE           ~ "Passed-QC"
      ),
      r4 = case_when(
        EXCFL == "Y"   ~ "-",
        DELFLAG == "Y" ~ "-",
        BLQ == "Y"     ~ "BLQ",
        TRUE           ~ "Quantifiable"
      ),
      r5 = case_when(
        EXCFL == "Y"   ~ "-",
        DELFLAG == "Y" ~ "-",
        BLQ == "Y"     ~ "-",
        TRUE           ~ "Final Records"
      ),
      path = paste(r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, sep = "/")
    ) %>%
    count(path, name = "size") %>%
    arrange(path)
}
 
# Run pipeline
sunburst_paths <- build_attrition_paths(adpc)
 
print(sunburst_paths)

 
summarise_attrition <- function(data) {
 
  studies <- data %>% distinct(STUDYID) %>% pull()
 
  summarise_study <- function(sid) {
 
    d <- data %>% filter(STUDYID == sid)
 
    n_raw <- nrow(d)
 
    # Stage 1: remove excluded subjects
    d_comp <- d %>% filter(EXCFL == "N")
    n_comp <- nrow(d_comp)
 
    # Stage 2: remove deleted samples
    d_qc <- d_comp %>% filter(DELFLAG == "N")
    n_qc <- nrow(d_qc)
 
    # Stage 3: remove BLQ
    d_final <- d_qc %>% filter(BLQ == "N")
    n_final <- nrow(d_final)
 
    tibble(
      Study                        = sid,
      `Raw samples`                = n_raw,
      `After subject exclusions`   = n_comp,
      `% remaining`                = round(n_comp / n_raw * 100, 1),
      `After sample QC flags`      = n_qc,
      `% remaining `               = round(n_qc  / n_raw * 100, 1),
      `After BLQ removal`          = n_final,
      `% remaining  `              = round(n_final / n_raw * 100, 1)
    )
  }
 
  map_dfr(studies, summarise_study)
}
 
attrition_summary <- summarise_attrition(adpc)
 
# Wide print for easy review
attrition_summary %>%
  print(width = Inf)
 
# Also print percent-only view for quick comparison to targets
attrition_summary %>%
  select(
    Study,
    `Raw`                = `Raw samples`,
    `After excl (%)`     = `% remaining`,
    `After QC (%)`       = `% remaining `,
    `After BLQ (%)`      = `% remaining  `
  ) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
js_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".js")
writeLines("
  var sz = options.size;
  var W = width;
  var H = 900;
  var cx = W / 2;
  var cy = H / 2;
  var radius = sz;
  var innerR = radius * 0.2;
  var ringW  = (radius - innerR) / 5;

  svg.attr('width', W).attr('height', H);
  svg.style('background-color', '#EEEEEE');
  // Title
  svg.append('text')
    .attr('x', W / 2)
    .attr('y', 30)
    .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
    .attr('font-size', '18px')
    .attr('font-weight', 'bold')
    .attr('fill', '#333')
    .text('PK Sample Attrition by Study');

  // Footnote
  svg.append('text')
    .attr('x', W / 2)
    .attr('y', H - 10)
    .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
    .attr('font-size', '12px')
    .attr('fill', '#888')
    .text('Data: Simulated from typical observed values | Viz: Louis M Penrod | #30DayChartChallenge');

  // Color scale keyed to top-level (depth-1) node names
  var color = d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain(['STUDY001', 'STUDY002', 'STUDY003'])
    .range(['#4e79a7', '#f28e2b', '#59a14f']);

  // Walk up to depth-1 ancestor to get the root color
  function getColor(d) {
    var ancestor = d;
    while (ancestor.depth > 1) ancestor = ancestor.parent;
    return color(ancestor.data.name);
  }

  function buildHierarchy(data) {
  var root = {name: 'root', children: []};
  data.forEach(function(row) {
    var parts = row.path.split('/').filter(p => p !== '-');
    var node = root;
    parts.forEach(function(part, i) {
      var child = node.children.find(c => c.name === part);
      if (!child) {
        child = {name: part, children: []};
        node.children.push(child);
      }
      if (i === parts.length - 1) child.value = (child.value || 0) + row.size;
      node = child;
    });
  });
  return root;
}

  var hierarchy = d3.hierarchy(buildHierarchy(data))
    .sum(d => d.value || 0);

var tree = buildHierarchy(data);

var hierarchy = d3.hierarchy(tree).sum(d => d.value || 0);


  d3.partition().size([2 * Math.PI, 1])(hierarchy);



  var arc = d3.arc()
    .startAngle(d => d.x0)
    .endAngle(d => d.x1)
    .innerRadius(d => innerR + d.depth * ringW)
    .outerRadius(d => innerR + (d.depth + 1) * ringW - 2)
    .padAngle(0.006);

  var g = svg.append('g')
    .attr('transform', 'translate(' + cx + ',' + cy + ')');

// Breadcrumb dimensions
  var bcW = 110;
  var bcH = 30;
  var bcSpacing = 3;
  var bcTip = 10;

  // Create breadcrumb group above the chart
  var bcGroup = svg.append('g')
    .attr('transform', 'translate(10, 55)');

  // Center label group
  var centerLabel = g.append('text')
    .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
    .style('visibility', 'hidden');

  centerLabel.append('tspan')
    .attr('class', 'pct')
    .attr('x', 0)
    .attr('y', '-0.3em')
    .attr('font-size', '24px')
    .attr('fill', '#333')
    .attr('font-weight', 'bold');

  centerLabel.append('tspan')
    .attr('class', 'label')
    .attr('x', 0)
    .attr('y', '1em')
    .attr('font-size', '11px')
    .attr('fill', '#666');

  centerLabel.append('tspan')
    .attr('class', 'label')
    .attr('x', 0)
    .attr('y', '2.5em')
    .attr('font-size', '11px')
    .attr('fill', '#666');

  function breadcrumbPoints(d, i) {
    var points = [];
    points.push('0,0');
    points.push(bcW + ',0');
    points.push(bcW + bcTip + ',' + (bcH / 2));
    points.push(bcW + ',' + bcH);
    points.push('0,' + bcH);
    if (i > 0) points.push(bcTip + ',' + (bcH / 2));
    return points.join(' ');
  }

  function updateBreadcrumbs(ancestors, pct) {
    bcGroup.selectAll('g').remove();
    bcGroup.selectAll('text').remove();

    var bc = bcGroup.selectAll('g')
      .data(ancestors)
      .join('g')
        .attr('transform', (d, i) => 'translate(' + i * (bcW + bcSpacing + bcTip) + ', 0)');

    bc.append('polygon')
      .attr('points', (d, i) => breadcrumbPoints(d, i))
      .attr('fill', d => getColor(d))
      .attr('opacity', 0.8);

    bc.append('text')
      .attr('x', (bcW + bcTip) / 2)
      .attr('y', bcH / 2)
      .attr('dy', '0.35em')
      .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
      .attr('fill', 'white')
      .attr('font-size', '11px')
      .text(d => d.data.name);

    // Percentage at the end of the chain
    bcGroup.append('text')
      .attr('x', ancestors.length * (bcW + bcSpacing + bcTip) + 10)
      .attr('y', bcH / 2)
      .attr('dy', '0.35em')
      .attr('fill', '#333')
      .attr('font-size', '12px')
      .text(pct + '%');
  }

  // Visible paths
  var path = g.append('g')
    .selectAll('path')
    .data(hierarchy.descendants().filter(d => d.depth > 0 && d.x1 - d.x0 > 0.001))
    .join('path')
      .attr('d', arc)
      .attr('fill', d => getColor(d))
      .attr('fill-opacity', d => 1 - (d.depth - 1) * 0.15)
      .attr('stroke', 'white')
      .attr('stroke-width', 0.5);

  // Invisible mouse target paths (slightly wider hit area)
  var mousearc = d3.arc()
    .startAngle(d => d.x0)
    .endAngle(d => d.x1)
    .innerRadius(d => innerR + d.depth * ringW)
    .outerRadius(d => innerR + (d.depth + 1) * ringW + 5)
    .padAngle(0.006);

  g.append('g')
    .attr('fill', 'none')
    .attr('pointer-events', 'all')
    .on('mouseleave', function() {
      path.attr('fill-opacity', d => 1 - (d.depth - 1) * 0.15);
      centerLabel.style('visibility', 'hidden');
      bcGroup.style('visibility', 'hidden');
    })
    .selectAll('path')
    .data(hierarchy.descendants().filter(d => d.depth > 0 && d.x1 - d.x0 > 0.001))
    .join('path')
      .attr('d', mousearc)
      .on('mouseenter', function(event, d) {
        var ancestors = d.ancestors().reverse().slice(1);
        var rootNode = d;
        while (rootNode.parent) rootNode = rootNode.parent;
        var pct = ((100 * d.value) / rootNode.value).toPrecision(3);

        path.attr('fill-opacity', node =>
          ancestors.indexOf(node) >= 0 ? 1.0 : 0.3
        );

        // Study-level percentage — walk up to depth-1 ancestor
        var studyNode = d;
        while (studyNode.depth > 1) studyNode = studyNode.parent;
        var pctStudy = ((100 * d.value) / studyNode.value).toPrecision(3);

        centerLabel.style('visibility', null);
        centerLabel.selectAll('tspan').nodes()[0].textContent = d.data.name;
        centerLabel.selectAll('tspan').nodes()[1].textContent = pctStudy + '% of ' + studyNode.data.name;
        centerLabel.selectAll('tspan').nodes()[2].textContent = pct + '% overall';

        

        updateBreadcrumbs(ancestors, pct);
        bcGroup.style('visibility', 'visible');
      });

  bcGroup.style('visibility', 'hidden');
", js_file)

r2d3::r2d3(
  data       = sunburst_paths,
  script     = js_file,
  height     = 1200,
  options = list(size = 325),
  d3_version = "6"
)
```
